question: Which of the following books is authored by Dalai Lama and launched by him in February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Little Book of Encouragement.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Little Book of Encouragement**

 
 
• The Book comprises 130 quotes.
 
• Renuka Singh has edited the book and Penguin Random House has published the book.
 
• It promotes human values, spills the beans on a key to happiness and comments on Sino-India ties.
 
• Dalai Lama praises India's rich civilisational heritage.
 
• The Dalai Lama rightly points to our 'emotional hygiene that helps the mind and heart to gain inner strength, peace, clarity, and happiness.
 
 
 
• **Dalai Lama**__
 __
 
• Dalai Lama is a title given by the Tibetan people for the foremost spiritual leader of the Gelug or "Yellow Hat" school of Tibetan Buddhism.
 
• There have been only 14 Dalai Lamas in the history of Tibetan Buddhism.
 
• The 14th and current Dalai Lama is Tenzin Gyatso.
